landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.hint: The iconic international-orange suspension bridge at the mouth of the bay

landmarks.name: Alcatraz Island
landmarks.hint: A rocky island in the bay that housed a notorious federal penitentiary

landmarks.name: Fisherman's Wharf
landmarks.hint: A waterfront neighbourhood famous for sourdough bread and sea lions at Pier 39

landmarks.name: Coit Tower
landmarks.hint: A fluted concrete tower atop Telegraph Hill with panoramic views of the bay

landmarks.name: Palace of Fine Arts
landmarks.hint: A Roman-style rotunda and colonnade in the Marina, built for the 1915 World Exposition

landmarks.name: Ferry Building
landmarks.hint: A landmark clock-tower terminal on the Embarcadero where ferries cross the bay

landmarks.name: Oracle Park
landmarks.hint: Home of the San Francisco Giants, with views of McCovey Cove beyond right field

landmarks.name: City Hall
landmarks.hint: A Beaux-Arts civic building with one of the largest domes in the United States

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Park
landmarks.hint: A vast urban park stretching to the Pacific, larger than Central Park

landmarks.name: Twin Peaks
landmarks.hint: Two prominent hills near the geographic centre of the city, with sweeping 360° views
